problem.title: Covering by Random Translates
problem.statement: If A subset Z/pZ is random with |A| = sqrt(p), can we almost surely cover Z/pZ with 100*sqrt(p) translates of A?
problem.site_status_checked: 2026-08-17 triage; Green: open even with constant 1.01

model.A: uniform random k-subset, k = floor(sqrt(p)) (fixed-cardinality model)
model.reading_RA: the 100*sqrt(p) translates t_1..t_m are i.i.d. uniform random
model.reading_RB: translates chosen optimally after seeing A; cov(A) = min{|B| : A+B = Z_p}; 'almost surely' over A only (Green's intended reading)

reading_RA_random_translates.theorem: Theorem 1.6(i): for m = C*floor(sqrt(p)), any fixed C>0, the number X of uncovered points satisfies E X = p(1-1/sqrt(p))^(C sqrt p) = p e^{-C}(1+o(1)) -> infinity and Var(X)/mu^2 -> 0, hence X >= (1-o(1)) p e^{-C} w.h.p. and Pr[full cover] -> 0.
reading_RA_random_translates.crossover: random 100*sqrt(p) translates cover w.h.p. iff p <~ e^{100} ~ 2.69e43 (Corollary 1.7); mu(997)=7.246e-42, mu(10007)=2.262e-40
reading_RA_random_translates.threshold: Pr[cover] -> 1 iff m/sqrt(p) - ln(p) -> +infinity; threshold m* = sqrt(p) ln p (1+o(1))

best_partial_results: Lower bound: cov(A) >= ceil(p/k) for every A; no exact factorization of Z_p exists (Hajos-de Bruijn)
Deterministic upper: cov(A) <= (p/k)(1+ln k) = (1/2+o(1)) sqrt(p) ln p for EVERY A (Lovasz 1975 / Stein 1974 / Chvatal 1979)
a.s. upper: cov(A) <= (1+eps) sqrt(p) ln p with probability -> 1 (Prop 2.2)

Conditional/reduction theorem (Prop 2.5): cov(A) <= |B_0| + L_{B_0} for any partial cover; cov(A) <= |B_0| + sqrt(p) ln(L_{B_0}+1) + O(1) via averaging completion; hence GREEN-081(RB) TRUE follows if w.h.p. O(sqrt(p)) translates cover all but O(sqrt(p)) points
Empirical greedy benchmark: g ~ 0.288 sqrt(p) ln p at p=20011 (below the 1/2 ceiling, above O(sqrt p))
reading_RB_chosen_translates_green_origi.exact_missing_bridge: Prove Pr_A[exists B, |B| = O(sqrt(p)), leftover L_B = O(sqrt(p))] -> 1, equivalently beat the coupon-collector tail Pr[exists x : r_{A+B}(x) = 0] for adaptive B. Every current tool loses ln(p): union bound/second moment certify at most c/(1+c) < 1 fraction of coverage (Prop 2.4); matching/nibble design theory is structurally void because typical translates intersect in Theta(1) points (E c_d = k(k-1)/(p-1) -> 1); Chen-Stein dependency graph is complete so window-level Poisson precision (Conjecture 1.8) is already out of reach of standard bounds.

key_theorems.content: E X = p q^m exactly, q = 1-k/p
E X^2 = p q^m + p(p-1) g_m exactly, g_m = E_A[(1-(2k-c_d(A))/p)^m]
Naive surrogate f^m with f = C(p-2,k)/C(p,k) is wrong by Jensen gap; caught by exhaustive enumeration
g_m = q^{2m}(1 + O_C(1/p)) for m <= C sqrt(p)
Var(X) <= mu + K'(C) mu^2/p; Var/mu^2 -> 0 when mu -> infinity
RA threshold theorem; RA reading of GREEN-081 asymptotically FALSE
e^{100} crossover scale; explains simulation invisibility
Gumbel window: m/sqrt(p)-ln p -> c implies X => Poisson(e^{-c}), Pr[cover] -> exp(-e^{-c})
cov(A) <= (p/k)(1+ln k) = (1/2+o(1)) sqrt(p) ln p deterministically
Energy/CS certificate caps below full coverage: c/(1+c)*p < p; E(E(A)) = 2p+o(p) near-minimal but tail-blind
Completion lemma cov(A) <= M + ceil(sqrt(p) ln(L+1)) + 1; reduction cov(A) <= |B_0| + L_{B_0}

highlights: exhaustive enumeration matches corrected closed forms exactly as Fractions at (p,k,m)=(7,2,3),(13,3,4)
MC p=101,k=10,m=100: mean within 4SE, sd relerr 0.027
